verdict.rationale: MailerLite's developer docs describe a RESTful API with API-key machine-to-machine authentication and a campaigns section to draft, schedule, send and cancel email campaigns. That covers creating and scheduling a campaign without the dashboard. Missing for 10: endpoint-level detail of the campaign create/schedule request (the evidence is a summary line only, and no OpenAPI spec was found), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Draft, schedule, send, and cancel email campaigns, plus retrieve campaign reports and link clicks.
Push or pull data from our RESTful API.
API keys are a quick way to implement machine-to-machine authentication without any direct inputs from a human beyond initial setup.
